about.title: About
about.tagline: Your repertoire, setlists and gigs — ready for the stage.
about.projectDescription: Setlyst is a musician's companion for the stage. Keep the lyrics of your own repertoire — with chords if you want them — build setlists, organise your gigs, and perform with a Live Mode designed to be read from a mic stand: live transposition, metronome, auto-scroll, compact mode and full offline support.
about.openSource: Solo or with your band, everything you need to step on stage lives in one place. Setlyst is open source — a Next.js web app and a Rust API, built in the open by musicians, for musicians.
about.author: Author
about.authorRole: Guitarist, guitar teacher and software developer
about.authorBio: Setlyst is designed and built by a working guitarist who also writes software — so every feature is shaped by what's actually needed on stage.
about.contributeTitle: Found a bug or have an idea?
about.contributeDescription: Issues and pull requests are welcome.
